The plate looks like a side plate of about 20-22 cm, spanning roughly 360 px in the image. That works out to about 0.058 cm per px.

Each sausage is about 130 px long, or roughly 7.5 cm, and about 55 px wide, or roughly 3 cm. They look like short, thick sausages, perhaps cut pieces or small bratwurst. A cylinder 7.5 cm long and 3 cm across has a volume of about 53 cm³, so each weighs roughly 50 g. The two together come to about 100-110 g.

Sausage runs at about 250-300 kcal per 100 g, so 105 g is roughly 290 kcal.
